title: Genomic and cytogenetic evidence for divergence and speciation in geladas.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: paper_context.py: no PMCID, no open full text, no supplement listing, no text-mined accessions, no NCBI links, no Zenodo/Dryad hits. An NCBI search found 3 gelada BioProjects and 319 SRA (Sequence Read Archive, raw reads) records for Theropithecus gelada. All are raw sequencing data, which I did not download under project rules.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: 149 whole-genome-sequenced individuals from 3 populations, cytogenetic data from 10 animals, and the chromosome 7 fission findings all come from the abstract only. The paper's own data availability statement was not retrievable.

a1_downloadable.note: No processed table was found. The only data located is raw reads in SRA (Sequence Read Archive), seen in an NCBI search and not opened; the paper's deposit could not be confirmed because there is no open full text.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: There is no label column. This is a population-genetics study. The only candidate label is population (north/central/south) or karyotype, and it would have to be built from genotypes called from raw reads.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs would be variant calls that have to be made from raw whole-genome reads. No processed VCF (variant call file) was found.

a4_units_stated.note: Not applicable. There is no measured quantitative outcome.

a5_enough_rows.note: 149 individuals per the abstract (not verified), well under the ~400 needed even for classification.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: Raw whole-genome reads for 149 primates, likely terabytes (not verified)
a6_fits_laptop.note: Calling variants from raw reads is not laptop-feasible, and raw sequencing downloads are banned by project rules.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Could not compare. The paper text was not available, and the SRA records were not tied to this paper.

a8_label_provenance.note: Population labels come from sampling location, and the karyotype is known for only 10 animals. Any label inferred from genotype data would be circular.

honest_claim_h3: None possible: no labelled table exists, only raw genomes from 149 animals.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use genome-wide genetic variation in geladas to predict which population or chromosome form an animal carries.
plain_idea.train_on: Genetic variants from 149 whole genomes (count from the abstract, not verified). These would have to be called from raw reads first.
plain_idea.predict: Population of origin or chromosome 7 karyotype. The karyotype is measured by cytogenetics (looking at chromosomes under a microscope) in only 10 animals.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Little. Population assignment from genotypes is a solved, non-ML problem, and 10 karyotyped animals cannot train a model.

ml_idea: None viable. This is a descriptive population-genomics study with raw-read data only and no outcome column.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated, because the project fails Part A. Raw whole-genome data would far exceed a laptop.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Look for a processed VCF (variant call file) deposit with this paper. None was found.

verdict_reason: Raw whole-genome reads from 149 geladas only, with no label column. Karyotypes exist for 10 animals, and the data is far too large for a laptop.
